items.headline: 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry Awarded for Discoveries in Mirror-Image Molecules
items.summary: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry was awarded to scientists Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai for their work on non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric synthesis. Their discoveries solved a long-standing mystery about how molecular handedness develops, providing vital tools for modern pharmaceutical development.

items.headline: 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry Awarded for Solving Century-Old Molecular Mystery
items.summary: On October 7, the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry to scientists Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai. Their discoveries solved a century-old mystery explaining how single-handed mirror-image molecules form, a breakthrough with major applications in safer drug manufacturing.

items.headline: Novak Djokovic Wins 102nd Career Title at China Open
items.summary: Novak Djokovic secured his seventh China Open title in Beijing after opponent Alex de Minaur retired due to injury during the second set of the final. The victory gave the 39-year-old Serbian his 102nd career singles title, extending his record of winning at least one ATP trophy to 21 consecutive seasons.

items.headline: Emmy Awards to Move Exclusively to Prime Video in Historic Six-Year Streaming Deal
items.summary: The Television Academy announced a landmark six-year agreement with Amazon Prime Video to exclusively stream the Emmy Awards live worldwide starting in 2027. This decision ends more than seven decades of traditional broadcast network coverage, making the annual event free to stream globally without requiring a paid subscription.
